title: chaosD6 skill definition (chaosd6.skill/1) and skill library (chaosd6.skill-lib/1)
description: Structural schema. Semantic checks (known hooks, known operations of the skill vocabulary, known subroutines, JS markers only on built-ins) are done by skill-engine.mjs#validateSkillDef / validateSkillLib (skills.mjs#validateSkillDef); see SCHEMA.md.

logic.description: A program in the effects' JsonLogic dialect (effects-data/SCHEMA.md): a primitive, an array (evaluated element-wise) or an object with exactly ONE key (the operation).

jsMarker.description: The hook stays in JS (built-in skills only): impl names the function (skills.mjs#… or peer.mjs#…).

source.description: Where the metadata came from (data/skills.json active version) — provenance only.

action_type.description: The action card it rides on (M / P also ride on EM / EP).

point_buy_stat.description: Rule 12 / 24 stat of a permanent; null for an instant.

flags.description: Two vocabularies in one object (SCHEMA.md): the resolver flags = skills.mjs SKILL_RULES[id] (action, permanent, pointBuyStat, negating, hooks, range, negates, keepsTarget, trance, attackBonus, damageOff) and the S5 validator's priced flags (FLAG_KEYS: attackBonus, damageOff, negate, altCounterSkill, counterSkill, counterElement, trance, blockImmune, trapImmune, tauntGuard, immuneTo, restInvincible, effectShield).

uses.description: Library ids whose subroutines `call` may use (searched in order).

defaults.description: hook → sub: the program of a per-skill hook (rides, plan_target, perm_landing, perm_stats, disposition) for a skill without its own.
